description: Classic checks, cut with a modern edge. This cropped shirt is designed in a regular silhouette that keeps things easy yet elevated. The timeless plaid pattern adds everyday versatility, while the button-down front and structured collar keep it sharp. With its slightly boxy fit, it’s the perfect piece to balance comfort and style. Pair it with high-waist denim or tailored trousers for an effortless, off-duty look.
